finalists.kill_threshold: 4/5 deterministic cases fully resolved from incumbent evidence
finalists.survival_threshold: 2/5 require manual reconstruction with structural evidence gap

finalists.incumbent: Model Action Protocol (MAP) plus strongest accessible agent audit stack
finalists.kill_threshold: 8/8 reconstruction facts satisfied without trusting acting-agent narrative
finalists.survival_threshold: >=1 required fact unavailable or only inferred across boundary

common_stop: No MVP work before a finalist survives falsification.
